description:
Inspect saved templates in the connected organization without creating
    a draft or sending anything. Returns summaries with template_id, name,
    roles, filename, document_count, field_count, and timestamps, not PDF
    contents or individual field definitions. Use template_id and roles with
    send_from_template to send a new envelope, or add_document_to_draft to
    append the template to an existing draft without sending.
    Requires envelopes:read access.
name: list_templates
title: List Templates
